nodes.condition: Operator rebuilds pre-filter-worker and enrichment-batcher images, restarts compose with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY resolvable, and lets at least one gate submit two batches on the same cache key. PASS when the batch-poller completion log line for the second batch reports cache_read_tokens > 0. FAIL when all keys report event=cache_read_zero across two consecutive completed batches. A FAIL is a section-7 amendment trigger. The only alternative close is an explicit operator budget waiver recorded against this condition by name.
